title: Final Rest
description: Three graves west of Crossroads have gone unmarked since spring - a family of tanners who caught the fever on the road and never made it as far as Dalhurst. Whoever traveled with them buried nobody and kept walking; the priest does not know if that was cowardice or if there was no one left standing well enough to dig. He does not need to know. Morthane's doctrine does not ask who the dead were before it demands they be honored - it asks only that someone finally does the honoring.

objectives.description: Find the tanner family's unmarked graves west of Crossroads
Give the three of them the rites nobody else stayed to give
Return to the Priest of Morthane

notes: The line's named failure: unburied dead nobody buried, with who they were and why nobody came left unwritten. Fixed - a tanner family who caught fever on the road and were abandoned by whoever they traveled with, invented for this quest since the bible names no specific dead here. Giver motive: doctrine, not sentiment - Morthane's priest does not need a sympathetic backstory to demand rites, which is itself the doctrine in action. Consequence: not wired; left unburied they remain a standing offense to the cycle in prose only.
